description: The signed-in traveller's trip plans in the Meridian Dispatch app: id, title, dates, countries, number of days planned (the app makes days as the traveller fills them, so it can be fewer than the dates span), seq (the plan's version), whether the app has taken in the latest version, and when it last changed. Needs the traveller to sign in to Meridian Dispatch the first time (the client is asked to authorise). Use get_plan for one plan's days and places.
name: list_my_plans
title: List my Meridian Dispatch plans
